video.title: Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft [ESPN Points Scoring Format] - Pick 10

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 10-team mock draft using ESPN points scoring, picking 10th. Most of this is about ESPN points value, not 9-category value. He says many picks went too early for this format, including Anthony Edwards, Donovan Mitchell, Kevin Durant and Karl-Anthony Towns. He thinks players like Tyrese Haliburton, Kyrie Irving, LeBron James, Matas Buzelis, Jaren Jackson Jr. and De'Aaron Fox fell too far. His team was Cooper Flagg, Jalen Johnson, Jalen Brunson, Domantas Sabonis, Dyson Daniels, Chet Holmgren, Donovan Clingan, Kel'el Ware, CJ McCollum, Collin Murray-Boyles, Cedric Coward, Jalen Green, Jeremiah Fears and Neemias Queta. His own projections rated it the best team in the draft. His main strategy points: know your format and league structure, and take risky flyers late in shallow leagues because the waiver wire will be deep.

rules.text: Know the scoring system and league structure before you draft. Many picks are only too early or too late because of the format.
rules.quote: there is importance in knowing what your structure is and what what the idea of this draft is

rules.text: In a 10-team league the waiver wire is deeper. You can take more risk and draft late-round flyers, because a failed pick is easy to replace by streaming.
rules.quote: this is a 10 team league. So the waiver wire is going to be more chockers. So feel free to take flyers

rules.text: In shallow leagues, be risk forward and flyer forward in the late rounds because of how the league is set up.
rules.quote: I'm happy to be risk forward, flyer forward in this sort of scenario because

rules.text: Be careful about stacking too many older or previously injured players on one roster, even when each one looks like good value.
rules.quote: that's a lot of like older guys, a lot of previously injured guys

rules.text: Rookies often get their fantasy value from defensive stats. Those count less in points leagues.
rules.quote: his value for a rookie in fantasy is going to come from defensive stats, and that's not going to count

rules.text: Inefficient scorers get penalized in ESPN points scoring.
rules.quote: he will get a penalty in this format because of inefficiency

rules.text: Drafts with an odd number of rounds give the first pick one more first-in-round pick than the last pick. He prefers 14 rounds with four bench spots.
